option.name: originalContent
option.value:
# GEMINI_API_KEY: Required for Gemini AI API calls. # AI Studio automatically injects this at runtime from user secrets. # Users configure this via the Secrets panel in the AI Studio UI. GEMINI_API_KEY="MY_GEMINI_API_KEY"
# APP_URL: The URL where this applet is hosted. # AI Studio automatically injects this at runtime with the Cloud Run service URL. # Used for self-referential links, OAuth callbacks, and API endpoints. APP_URL="MY_APP_URL"
# VITE_API_BASE_URL: (Optional) Base URL for API calls # Leave empty or commented out for local development (uses relative paths). # Set this when deploying to Android/mobile or when backend is on a different domain. # Examples: # - Google Cloud Run: https://your-app-xxxxx.run.app # - Railway: https://your-app.railway.app # - Render: https://your-app.onrender.com # - Fly.io: https://your-app.fly.dev # VITE_API_BASE_URL="https://your-backend-domain.com"

option.name: updatedContent
option.value: # Gemini API key exposed to the React app via Vite. # This enables direct client-side calls without a backend server. VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY="MY_GEMINI_API_KEY"

option.name: originalContent
option.value: # Run and deploy your AI Studio app This contains everything you need to run your app locally. View your app in AI Studio: https://ai.studio/apps/64589ee6-64f8-4b51-a6eb-d00f5f0a98b8 ## Run Locally **Prerequisites:** Node.js 1. Install dependencies: `npm install` 2. Set the `GEMINI_API_KEY` in [.env.local](.env.local) to your Gemini API key 3. Run the app: `npm run dev`

option.name: updatedContent
option.value: # Run app (Gemini client-side) Questa app ora chiama Gemini direttamente dal client React, senza backend Node. View your app in AI Studio: https://ai.studio/apps/64589ee6-64f8-4b51-a6eb-d00f5f0a98b8 ## Run locally **Prerequisites:** Node.js 1. Installa le dipendenze: `npm install` 2. Crea `.env.local` con: `VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY=la_tua_chiave_google_ai_studio` 3. Avvia in sviluppo: `npm run dev` 4. Build di produzione: `npm run build`
